seoTitle: Go Code Re-indenter in gofmt Style
metaDescription: Re-indent Go code with tabs the way gofmt lays out blocks and switch cases. It does not align comments or struct fields. Free, in your browser.
intro: Fixes indentation, blank lines and optionally line breaks in Go code without sending it anywhere.
why:
Messy indentation hides the structure of Go code, and minified or copy-pasted code is worse. A re-indenter gives you the block layout back quickly.

The tool reads your code with a small scanner that knows strings, comments and raw literals, so braces inside them are ignored. It then sets the indent from bracket depth and, if you ask, puts a line break after braces and semicolons. It is not gofmt.
howTo: Run gofmt locally for the final check.

faq.q: Is this the same as gofmt?
faq.a: No. gofmt also aligns comments, struct fields and key-value pairs and normalises spacing. This tool fixes block indentation and blank lines. On the Go standard library, re-indenting files with all indentation stripped restored 166 of 187 files byte for byte; indentation of already-formatted files was kept in 202 of 208.

faq.q: Will it change what my code does?
faq.a: It only changes whitespace outside strings, comments and raw literals. Test results: the non-whitespace text was unchanged on all test files, and re-running the tool gave the same output. Review the diff anyway.
Wrapping needs a full parser. This tool does not have one.
No. Everything runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded.
